run_binarized_data_cli: run the binarized_data CLI to tokenize text and save token IDs as a pickle file
run_binarized_data_with_custom_tokenizer: run the binarized_data script with a custom BERT tokenizer and input data file
run_binarized_data_with_custom_output: run the binarized_data script to dump tokenized results to a custom output file path
run_binarized_data_shuffle: run the binarized_data script to tokenize, shuffle, and pickle text data for distillation
run_binarized_data_preprocess: run the binarized_data module to preprocess text data by tokenizing and converting to IDs
